PLAN_TITLE: G2-17473 UAT — Near Real-Time Address Sync WCS to Tapir
EPIC_SUMMARY: Near real-time sync from WCS to Tapir - Addresses
EPIC_CREATED_BY: Cobbe, Valentina || YOOX NET A PORTER
TARGET_URLS: Integ WCS (address change trigger), Acceptance Tapir Admin (sync verification target)
COVERAGE_SUMMARY: 3 UI-testable stories mapped to 10 business checks and 10 coverage rows. Bug G2-20787 (province sync regression, now Closed) informs regression scenario only.
STORIES_IN_SCOPE:
G2-17012 | Registered User Adds a New Address | Done
G2-17013 | Registered User Updates an Address | Done
G2-17014 | Registered User Deletes an Address | Done
STORIES_EXCLUDED: G2-20787 | Province not updated in shipping address during sync | Bug/defect ticket (Closed); informs exploratory regression scenario but is not a user story for direct UAT execution.
OUT_OF_SCOPE: Sync of non-registered (guest) users' addresses, WCS bulk import flows, Tapir Admin UI rendering completeness beyond address persistence, direct Tapir-to-WCS reverse address sync, and backend observability/monitoring validation.
DEV_EVIDENCE: GitHub MCP (org:mytheresa) search recovered merged PRs across two repos: tapir (Catalog Service, the Tapir target) and ant (Middleware between WCS and Tapir). G2-17012 (Add address): tapir#6419 'Add registered user add address endpoint' (merged 2025-11-21) + ant#37 'registered user adds a new address' (merged 2025-11-21). G2-17013 (Update address): ant#42 'update addresses' (merged 2025-12-05); the tapir-side update PR #6451 was closed UNMERGED (labeled 'do NOT merge'/'work in progress'), so the update path landed in the ant middleware. G2-17014 (Delete address): tapir#6489 'registered user deletes an address' (merged 2026-01-09, labels 'Contains Migrations','Porter' — includes a DB schema migration). Bug G2-20873 (clone of G2-20787): tapir#6634 'Improve handling of non-existing addresses in SyncAddressProcessor' (merged 2026-03-04) removed the non-blank requirement on addressId so a delete/sync for an address absent in Tapir no longer fails validation. No PR found for province-regression bug G2-20787. PR bodies for the add/update/delete stories use the boilerplate template (no per-field changelog); evidence is at endpoint/handler level. Story availability: G2-17012, G2-17013, G2-17014 Available; province regression Unavailable.
GAPS_SUMMARY: Add/update/delete PRs confirm the endpoints and middleware handlers exist, but their PR bodies are boilerplate (no explicit per-field mapping, address-type, or default-flag changelog) — those attribute checks remain evidenced only at AC level. No PR found for the province/state regression (G2-20787): province_name is stored in DB per developer comment but Tapir Admin UI display was unresolved at bug close; coverage deferred to exploratory scenario. tapir#6451 (update) was abandoned unmerged — verify the update path is fully served by the ant middleware (ant#42). Confluence page linked in G2-17013 (CD1 | Analysis | Customer Addresses Sync) not retrieved; AC from Jira remains canonical. Latency SLA (<5s) is defined at initiative level (G2-16119), not in child story AC.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Contact: Cobbe, Valentina || YOOX NET A PORTER
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Adding a new address via WCS MyAccount Address Book is synchronized to Tapir
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Log in to a registered user account on WCS. Navigate to MyAccount > Address Book and add a new address with all required fields. The WCS event is consumed by the ant middleware (ant#37) and posted to the Tapir add-address endpoint (tapir#6419). Wait for sync, then inspect the address in Tapir (admin or API) to confirm the new record is present.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
The new address appears in Tapir with matching street, city, postal code, region, and country values.
Address is created without error and the sync completes without manual intervention.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Contact: Cobbe, Valentina || YOOX NET A PORTER
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Adding a new address during WCS checkout (Shipping Details) is synchronized to Tapir
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Log in as a registered user on WCS. Proceed to checkout and add a new shipping address in the Shipping Details step. Complete or abandon the checkout flow. The add-address event flows through the same ant#37 middleware handler to the tapir#6419 endpoint. Verify the address exists in Tapir.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
The new address entered during checkout is present in Tapir with all fields matching the input.
Sync occurs without requiring additional user action after address entry.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Updating an existing address via WCS MyAccount Address Book is synchronized to Tapir
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Log in as a registered user on WCS. Navigate to MyAccount > Address Book, select an existing address, and change at least one field (e.g., street or city). Save the change. The update event is processed by the ant middleware update-addresses path (ant#42). Verify the updated address in Tapir; confirm the existing record is modified in place, not duplicated.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
The updated field values are reflected in Tapir after sync.
No duplicate address record is created; the existing record is modified in place.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Updating an existing address during WCS checkout (Shipping Details) is synchronized to Tapir
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Log in as a registered user on WCS. Proceed to checkout, select an existing address and edit it in the Shipping Details step. Proceed past that step. Verify the updated address in Tapir.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
The edited address is updated in Tapir to match the values entered during checkout.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Contact: Cobbe, Valentina || YOOX NET A PORTER
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Deleting an address via WCS MyAccount Address Book propagates the deletion to Tapir
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Log in as a registered user on WCS. Navigate to MyAccount > Address Book and delete an existing address. Deletion is handled by tapir#6489 (includes a DB migration). Verify in Tapir that the address record no longer exists. Also test deleting an address that does not exist in Tapir: per tapir#6634, the SyncAddressProcessor tolerates a blank/absent addressId and should not raise a validation error (event handled gracefully / routed to DLQ).
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
The deleted address is removed from Tapir after sync completes.
No orphaned or ghost record remains in Tapir for the deleted address.

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: Province/state field visible in Tapir Admin UI after sync
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: Update a WCS address with a non-null province/state value. After sync, check the Tapir Admin address detail page to confirm province/state is rendered in the UI (not only stored in the province_name DB column).
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: Province/state value is visible in the Tapir Admin address detail UI, matching the WCS source value.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Impact: If province/state is silently stored but not displayed in Admin UI, operations staff cannot verify address accuracy; customer service and fulfillment correctness risks.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Evidence Notes: G2-20787 developer comment: province correctly stored in province_name column but not exposed in Tapir Admin UI at time of bug analysis (Feb 2026). Bug closed but admin UI display gap noted.

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: WCS deletion of a non-existing Tapir address triggers DLQ handling
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: Send a delete-address event from WCS for an address ID that does not exist in Tapir. Observe the Ant/message queue behavior and confirm the event ends in DLQ rather than causing an unhandled error or loop.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: The deletion message for a non-existing Tapir address is routed to the Dead Letter Queue without crashing the sync pipeline or blocking subsequent events.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Impact: Without proper DLQ handling, a delete event for a ghost/stale address could block the entire address sync queue or cause repeated retry storms.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Evidence Notes: G2-20873 (Closed bug, cloned from G2-20787): WCS deletion message of a non-existing Tapir address ends in DLQ. Confirmed by tapir#6634 (merged 2026-03-04) which removes the non-blank addressId validation requirement in SyncAddressProcessor so non-existing-address events are tolerated rather than erroring.

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: Sync ordering and idempotency under rapid consecutive address changes
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: Add a new address on WCS, then immediately update the same address before the first sync event lands in Tapir. Verify that the final state in Tapir reflects the most recent WCS state and no intermediate or phantom records are created.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: Tapir address reflects only the final state from WCS. Events are processed in order or deduplicated such that no stale intermediate state is persisted.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Impact: Out-of-order event processing could leave Tapir with stale address data, causing fulfillment failures for customers who updated their address close to order placement.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Evidence Notes: No explicit AC or evidence covers event ordering/idempotency. Gap identified from near-real-time event-driven architecture context.
